Trace, implement and test: 剑指 Offer II 090. 环形房屋偷盗

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
class Solution {
public:
    int rob(vector<int>& nums) {
        int n = nums.size();
        if (n == 1) {
            return nums[0];
        }
        return max(robRange(nums, 0, n - 2), robRange(nums, 1, n - 1));
    }

    int robRange(vector<int>& nums, int l, int r) {
        int f = 0, g = 0;
        for (; l <= r; ++l) {
            int ff = max(f, g);
            g = f + nums[l];
            f = ff;
        }
        return max(f, g);
    }
};
